title: Revise a ruling
description: Stages a revision to a saved Parsimony ruling using its exact current Notebook heads and digests. The revision keeps the same finding subject and evidence, and only a person can Apply it.
usage: Usage: motif parsimony revise <recordId> --project <fwdata> --draft <name> --expected-heads '<revisionId and contentDigest JSON array>' --disposition keep|fix|ask|defer [--reason <text> | --clear-reason] [--question <text>] [--json]
